guitar.modelsText: Turner Model 1 (Buckingham) / 1959 Gibson Les Paul "Greeny" (Peter Green)
guitar.evidence: Peter Green's 1959 Les Paul ('Greeny', later owned by Gary Moore/Kirk Hammett) is extremely famous; Lindsey Buckingham's Rick Turner Model 1 is also well documented as his main stage guitar from the late 70s onward.
guitar.notes: Upgraded from medium to high given how well documented both instruments are.

tone.target: articulate post-punk rock crunch with wah-riff bite
tone.profile: articulate post-punk rock crunch with wah-riff bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a Green OD boost for bite, followed by an AC30 TB amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab. The V-Wah is placed early in the chain to drive the riff's articulation, complemented by Chorus and Room ambience.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm definition.
Provide bright, articulate overdrive and grit for the crunchy rhythm sections.
Crucial for the 'wah-led riff' and adding post-punk bite and articulation.
Skipped. The Green OD and AC30 amp provide sufficient grit without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: The target tone requires controlled crunch rather than dedicated distortion units.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall-style crunch and bright upper mids required for the genre.
